a78b24e2-e330-45f8-af42-6b71ec0627ae.text_lemmatized: Mitosis has five phases: Interphase, Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, and Telophase.

8c072cab-47a1-4ff0-92ca-78450fa66164.data: During Interphase, the DNA in the cell is copied in preparation for cell division, resulting in two identical complete sets of chromosomes.
8c072cab-47a1-4ff0-92ca-78450fa66164.text_lemmatized: During Interphase, the DNA in the cell is copied in preparation for cell division, resulting in two identical complete sets of chromosomes.

f6368c31-a8d3-4bb0-8e3c-af9dd0c33888.data: In Prophase, chromosomes condense into X-shaped structures that can be easily seen under a microscope, and the membrane around the nucleus dissolves away releasing the chromosomes.
f6368c31-a8d3-4bb0-8e3c-af9dd0c33888.text_lemmatized: In Prophase, chromosomes condense into X-shaped structures that can be easily seen under a microscope, and the membrane around the nucleus dissolves away releasing the chromosomes.

53876110-b42d-40bc-9d4a-ba690e29f146.data: During Metaphase, the chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center of the cell, and the mitotic spindle fibers attach to each of the sister chromatids.
53876110-b42d-40bc-9d4a-ba690e29f146.text_lemmatized: During Metaphase, the chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center of the cell, and the mitotic spindle fibers attach to each of the sister chromatids.

f1d6351c-742d-4e99-b96f-0f13ad599ba9.data: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, with one chromatid going to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.
f1d6351c-742d-4e99-b96f-0f13ad599ba9.text_lemmatized: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, with one chromatid going to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.

39cadada-99ae-4fb4-84d7-3cf841dd75c3.data: In Telophase, a full set of chromosomes gather together at each pole of the cell, and a membrane forms around each set of chromosomes to create two new nuclei.
39cadada-99ae-4fb4-84d7-3cf841dd75c3.text_lemmatized: In Telophase, a full set of chromosomes gather together at each pole of the cell, and a membrane forms around each set of chromosomes to create two new nuclei.
